g.text: logical column (cell index within the 128-byte row)

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Highlighted column (x=0, the physical cell actually stored at logical column 0) lands in a DIFFERENT physical cell on every row —

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: so 8 threads reading "column 0" across 8 rows hit 8 different banks instead of colliding in one.
